name: @local/dsh-codex-skin
description: Codex-flavoured appearance layer for the DSH Web client: neutral palette, pale-blue user bubble, glowing white composer, chip-style inline code — plus the turn rail shown at every width and select-a-passage-as-an-attachment.

meta.title: Codex Skin
meta.description: Appearance plus two interaction touches: the Codex turn rail at every width, and attaching a selected passage to the next message as a file attachment.
